SOS Escalation Agent v1.0.0 — CRITICAL PRIORITY

Persist the SOS event first, alert controller and supervisors, start an acknowledgement timer, and escalate when unacknowledged. Continues safe processing if email/SMS/maps/n8n partially fail. Never auto-closes an SOS; requires an authorised human.

parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const s=$env.N8N_GUARDIANHUB_SIGNING_SECRET;if(!s)throw new Error('N8N_GUARDIANHUB_SIGNING_SECRET not configured');const body=$json.body||'';const sig=String($json.headers['x-gh-signature']||'').toLowerCase();const computed=crypto.createHmac('sha256',s).update(JSON.stringify(body)).digest('hex');if(sig!==computed)throw new Error('Invalid signature');const ts=parseInt($json.headers['x-gh-timestamp']||'0',10);if(!ts||Math.abs(Date.now()-ts)>300000)throw new Error('Expired timestamp');return[{json:{body,headers:$json.headers,timestamp:String(ts),nonce:$json.headers['x-gh-nonce']||'',correlation_id:$json.headers['x-gh-correlation-id']||''}}];

const crypto=require('crypto');const s=$env.N8N_CALLBACK_SIGNING_SECRET||$env.N8N_GUARDIANHUB_SIGNING_SECRET;const b=$json.body||'';const cb={run_id:b.run_id||'',agent_key:b.agent_key,company_id:b.company_id,event_type:b.event_type,status:'succeeded',result:{agent:'sos-escalation',message:'SOS alerts dispatched and acknowledgement timer started',processed_at:new Date().toISOString()}};const sig=s?crypto.createHmac('sha256',s).update(JSON.stringify(cb)).digest('hex'):'';return[{json:{callback:cb,signature:sig,timestamp:$json.timestamp,nonce:$json.nonce,correlation_id:$json.correlation_id}}];
